'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Paul Bonsall LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bonsall]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
